g.text: Education: B.Tech ECE + PG Cloud Computing

Airtel / Huawei: Zambia, Kenya, Malawi, Namibia
Azure IaC, Terraform, CI/CD, Enterprise Linux
PRIMARY PROJECT: TELECOM NETWORK MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (NMS) ON AZURE
Decoupled Single Page Application (SPA) hosting telecom NMS UI
• Low latency distribution to Telecom NOC operators
• Automated artifact sync in Azure DevOps Release Pipeline
• Hardened OS baseline, performance tuning & security patching
• Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) & secure SSH key authentication
• SSL termination, HTTP rate limiting, access log collection
• High-performance proxy pass to FastAPI ASGI daemon (localhost:8000)
• Asynchronous REST APIs, systemd process management & auto-restart
Managed relational engine for network topology & alarms
• Zero Public IP | Private Endpoint / VNet Integration
• NSG Rule: Inbound Port 5432 strictly from snet-backend-app
• Automated backups, point-in-time recovery & high availability
• Secrets stored in Azure Key Vault; monitored in Azure Monitor
• State hosted on Azure Blob Storage with automated lease-based state locking
• Static security & policy scanning: tflint, Checkov, and tfsec in PR gates
• Speculative terraform plan preview prior to approved multi-environment deployment
ENTERPRISE CI/CD PIPELINES (AZURE DEVOPS & GITHUB ACTIONS)
• Feature branch isolation (`feat/*`), mandatory peer code review approvals
• Automated PR validation builds & zero direct pushes to protected `main` branch
• Automated linting, pytest unit suites & drop artifact publishing in YAML pipelines
• Continuous Deployment: Automated Dev deploy -> Pre-prod Stage -> Prod Manual Gate
• Zero-downtime rolling service restart on Linux VM behind Nginx reverse proxy
